mapper.select: SELECT c.*,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),u.username,'已删除账号') AS author_name FROM afv_canvas_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=c.created_by WHERE c.canvas_id = #{canvasId} ORDER BY c.create_time, c.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT c.*,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),u.username,'已删除账号') AS author_name FROM afv_canvas_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=c.created_by WHERE c.canvas_id = #{canvasId} AND c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas_comment(id, canvas_id, node_id, parent_id, resource_version, content, created_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{canvasId}, #{nodeId}, #{parentId}, #{resourceVersion}, #{content}, #{actor}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_comment SET content = #{content}, resolved = #{resolved}, deleted = #{deleted}, version = version + 1, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE canvas_id = #{canvasId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = FALSE
